question: In June 2025, which authority made changes for reshaping motor insurance in India?

options.text: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** is the apex statutory body responsible for regulating and promoting the **insurance and re-insurance** industries in **India**.
 
• In **June 2024/2025**, **IRDAI** introduced a landmark **Master Circular on General Insurance** aimed at reshaping the landscape of **motor insurance** to make it more **customer-centric** and flexible.
 
• One of the primary changes includes the promotion of **usage-based insurance** models, such as **"Pay as You Drive"** and **"Pay How You Drive,"** allowing **policyholders** to pay premiums based on their **vehicle usage** and **driving habits**.
 
• The authority mandated that **insurers** must provide a **Customer Information Sheet (CIS)** in simple language, ensuring transparency regarding **policy coverage**, **exclusions**, and **claim procedures**.
